rows.Kwic: 壽開堂，三聖推出一僧，寶壽便打，三聖云：「與麼為人瞎卻鎮州一城人眼去在。」寶壽擲下拄杖，歸方丈。師云：「主寰中正令，握閫外威權，寶壽固是作家，簡點將來只得一半。若據山僧見處，當時待三聖恁麼道，和聲亦

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, hall address. Baichi Yuan is the exact commentator: after raising the Baoshou and Sansheng case, Baichi says that Baoshou commanded the true order within the realm and held authority beyond the gate, then gives his own judgment.

rows.Kwic: 總屬尋常，老幼賢愚一味平等，同彼同此，無是無非，渴飲饑餐隨緣任運，更說甚佛法玄妙、菩提涅槃？直饒臨濟當前也開臭口不得。政

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, hall address. Baichi Yuan is the exact speaker throughout the complete turn and places following conditions and letting things run directly after drinking when thirsty and eating when hungry.

rows.Kwic: 山川草木總屬尋常，老幼賢愚一味平等，同彼同此，無是無非，渴飲饑餐隨緣任運，更說甚佛法玄妙、菩提涅槃？直饒臨濟當前也開臭口不得。政

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, hall address. Baichi Yuan is the exact speaker throughout the complete turn and places letting things run together with following conditions after drinking when thirsty and eating when hungry.

rows.Kwic: 諸人未入門時，一句子已向汝舉揚了也，更待興問酬荅

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, requested hall address. Baichi Yuan is the exact speaker: after the opening verse he tells the assembly that before they entered the gate a phrase had already been raised and displayed to them.

rows.Kwic: 源，直截擔荷，自與乃佛乃祖握臂並行，生死不憂、涅槃不愛，隨緣放曠，應物施為，從前願力了然，一切深恩報盡。如是出家為僧不亦

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, hall instruction. Baichi Yuan is the exact speaker: while presenting the staff he describes directly carrying the source, following conditions freely, and responding to things.

rows.Kwic: 我手何似佛手？被人截斷了也。我腳何似驢腳？被人踏倒了也。人人盡有生緣，被人捉敗了也。

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, hall address. Baichi Yuan is the exact speaker: he recites Huanglong's three questions, including 'How is my foot like a donkey's foot?', and supplies his own repeated appraisals within the same turn.

rows.Kwic: 故我宗門有牧牛之說，梁山有十牛之頌

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, 自牧說. Baichi Yuan is the exact essay author: in his own explanation of self-herding he says that the Chan school has an account of herding the ox and Liangshan has verses on the Ten Oxen.

rows.Kwic: 梁山老漢做箇十牛頌子，可謂慈悲之故，落草之談

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, 題十牛圖. Baichi Yuan is the exact author of the inscription: he calls Liangshan's Ten-Ox verses compassionate talk descending into the weeds.

rows.Kwic: 後來人錯下手腳，更畫此十牛樣子

Override.AttributionNote: 百癡禪師語錄, 題十牛圖. Baichi Yuan is the exact author of the inscription: he says that later people made a wrong move and painted these Ten-Ox forms.
